sideEffects: write ignored build outputs and immutable local artifacts declared by the execution plan
keep input, output, loaded source, command captures, worker observations, diagnostics, and receipts in task-session memory only
purge every intermediate session object at each parent-skill terminal state

a current source hash differs from the approved build revision
